about: First Time? shows James Franco as a cowboy standing on the gallows with a noose around his neck and a calm, knowing half-smile. In the scene the man next to him is panicking, and Franco's character turns and asks, coolly, "first time?" because he has been in this situation before. As a meme it is used whenever a veteran of some recurring disaster watches a newcomer freak out about it: the joke is the veteran's weary calm in the face of something genuinely terrible.
origin: The scene is from the Coen brothers' Western anthology The Ballad of Buster Scruggs (2018), released on Netflix, in the segment "Near Algodones". It spread as a meme after the trailer came out in September 2018.
usage:
There is one text box, used for the newcomer's panic or the situation they are facing for the first time. Franco's face and the familiar line "first time?" supply the punchline, though some people write the line into the caption too.

Great fits are recurring miseries that veterans have stopped reacting to: production outages, final exam season, a franchise's yearly playoff collapse, a game's server crash on launch day. Frame it as a newcomer crying out so Franco's calm has something to contrast with.
ideas: you broke prod on your first day?
your game's servers crashed on launch day?
the printer jammed right before the deadline?
you got ghosted after one date?
